theorems.name: Submission.iwl_imc_density_zero_off_set
theorems.statement: ∀ (P k : ℕ) (U S : Set (Eucl P)) (g : Eucl P → ℝ≥0∞), IsOpen U → NullMeasurableSet S (μHE[k] : Measure (Eucl P)) → (∀ K : Set (Eucl P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → ∫⁻ y in S ∩ K, g y ∂(μHE[k] : Measure (Eucl P)) < ∞) → ∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[k] : Measure (Eucl P)), x ∈ U → x ∉ S → ∀ R : ℝ, 0 < R → Tendsto (fun r : ℝ => ENNReal.ofReal ((r ^ k)⁻¹) * ∫⁻ y in S ∩ closedBall x (R * r), g y ∂(μHE[k] : Measure (Eucl P))) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0)
